About Cloud Haven

Understand the business.

We start with the people doing the work. Together we examine what is happening now, what you want to change and how you will know it is working.

Set the scope.

Your proposal sets out priorities, ownership, timing and price. You can see what the team will deliver before the work begins.

Review what changes.

Your named contact shares the work completed and the measures agreed at the start. The next review turns those findings into practical decisions.
